main_text.head: Quod terra obtineat medium mundi locum, situmque centrum universi.
main_text.p: ARISTARCHVS Samius, qui ante annos mille octingentos uixit, terra medio mundi exemptam, & orbi peculiari inclusam intra Martis & Veneris sphæram collocauit, & motibus circumagi peculiaribus circa Solem in mundi medio immotum, more stellarum finxit. Et similes hypotheses Copernicus omnium, qui post Ptolemæum de doctrina Astrorum scripserunt summus, ad sua deas de

page.notes: The diagram is a woodcut of two circles on a vertical diameter, with the symbols ♂ (top), ♈ (bottom), and the letters β and α. The right margin is clipped; the last line reads "ad su-" and "as de-" in the right margin, shown as a note. A red library stamp at the left margin is omitted. Line-end hyphens in the right margin are cut off by the scan edge, so the text ends are uncertain.
